text: The Board confirms that each of these nominees is qualified to serve under the provisions of the City of Toronto's Public Appointments Policy and the Relationship Framework for Community Centre Boards of Management. On behalf of the Board, I respectfully request that the City take the necessary steps to appoint these nominated candidates. The Board also wishes to confirm that the following members, previously appointed by Community Council, continue to serve on the Board for the terms of office noted below and until successors are appointed: Gladys Akhigbe, for a term of office ending June 30, 2022.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Appointed the individuals listed below to the Scadding Court Community Center Board of Management, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending June 30, 2022, and until successors are appointed: Renaldo Jo Doug Lowry Peggy Poon Jasjit Sangha Joan Williams Stephen G. Foote Hilary Coleman Dan Fisher Mona Eldardiry Kenisha Peters
